title: POST /v1/systemone request
description: Protocol v0: the transport as Brain serves it (brain src/deskmind_brain/types.py). The agent profile constrains it further: protocol/agent/operations.yaml and agent-state.schema.json.

state.description: What the model looks at. An object is rendered as compact JSON (prompt_format 2 and 3); a string is used as is. Agent requests carry the agent state (agent-state.schema.json).

instructions.description: Any JSON value. Shown with the question. Agent requests use an object with goal and rules.

criteria.description: Option key -> description. Insertion order is the order the options are shown in (and the letters they get).
